function.name: send_message
function.description: Sends a new message to a specified recipient or channel. This tool can be used for direct messages or broadcast announcements.

recipient_id.description: The unique identifier of the user or channel to send the message to.

message_content.description: The actual text content of the message to be sent.

is_urgent.description: Set to true if the message should be marked as urgent, potentially triggering special notifications.

function.name: get_message_history
function.description: Retrieves a list of past messages for a given conversation or channel, allowing pagination and filtering by sender.

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation or channel to retrieve messages from.

limit.description: The maximum number of messages to retrieve. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

offset.description: The number of messages to skip before starting to retrieve results, used for pagination.

sender_id.description: Optional filter to only retrieve messages sent by a specific user.

function.name: edit_message
function.description: Modifies the content of an already sent message. This operation is typically restricted to the original sender and within a certain time frame.

message_id.description: The unique identifier of the message to be edited.

new_content.description: The new text content to replace the existing message content.

function.name: delete_message
function.description: Deletes a specific message from a conversation or channel. This action is usually irreversible and may require administrative privileges or be limited to the sender.

message_id.description: The unique identifier of the message to be deleted.

requester_id.description: The unique identifier of the user requesting the deletion. Used for permission checks.

force_delete.description: Set to true to bypass soft-delete mechanisms and permanently remove the message if permitted.

function.name: get_unread_message_count
function.description: Retrieves the total number of unread messages for a specific user across all their conversations or within a particular channel.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose unread message count is being queried.

channel_id.description: Optional: Filter unread messages for a specific channel. If omitted, counts across all channels.

function.name: mark_message_as_read
function.description: Marks one or more messages as read for a specific user. This updates the read status and helps manage notification states.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom messages are being marked as read.

message_ids.description: A comma-separated string of message IDs to mark as read. E.g., 'msg123,msg456'.

mark_all_in_conversation.description: If true, all unread messages in the specified conversation_id will be marked as read. message_ids will be ignored if this is true.

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation if 'mark_all_in_conversation' is true.

function.name: search_movies
function.description: Searches for movies based on various criteria like title, genre, and release year. This tool is useful for finding movies that match specific search terms.

title.description: The partial or full title of the movie to search for.

release_year.description: The release year of the movie.

min_rating.description: The minimum average user rating (0.0 to 10.0).

page.description: The page number for pagination, starting from 1.

page_size.description: The number of results per page, max 50.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie to add.
